name: Traditionalist
body:
Drawbacks
Traditionalist
Source Faiths and Philosophies pg. 33
Category Basic (Faith)
You spent a part of your youth far away from your homeland and your people. The experience of being a stranger in a strange land taught you to appreciate the support and understanding of the other members of your communal belief, and to never take it for granted. Though you still respect other cultures, you have come to see the way in which your particular culture keeps the knowledge of your people and their history alive, and feel that you have a responsibility to guard their traditions even when you are far from home. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) checks, and one of those skills (your choice) becomes a class skill for you.
